points: Excess collagen production with reduced breakdown during wound healing.
Triggers: acne, piercing, surgery (especially under tension), burns, vaccination, minor trauma.
**Keloids** are much more common in **skin of colour** and run in families.

cards.name: DFSP
cards.clue: Slowly enlarging plaque without a clear injury: biopsy

cards.name: Sarcoidosis in a scar
cards.clue: Purple papules in old scars; systemic signs

items.t: A rapidly growing or atypical ‘keloid’: exclude a tumour.
Keloid tendency or skin of colour before elective procedures: experienced operator only.

pearls.t: Keloids extend beyond the wound; hypertrophic scars do not.
OTC silicone gel is a reasonable first step for early raised scars: months, not weeks.

quiz.q: Name a red flag that needs escalation.
quiz.a: A rapidly growing or atypical ‘keloid’: exclude a tumour.
